literature.en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments. Four linked processes were identified: protective misrecognition through socially safer diagnostic categories; disclosure risk as the point where stigma, cost, distance, relationship risk, and service trust converged; health system co-production of delay through early diagnostic uncertainty, referral gaps, and limited diagnostic access; and enabling conditions that made care-seeking safer, especially trusted intermediaries and visible confidentiality practices. Two skin and four environmental samples were orthopoxvirus and MPXV positive. [10.1093/trstmh/trag112]. The review concludes that vaccination against mpox is effective, with no major areas of disagreement. The pooled estimate suggests a significant reduction in mpox incidence among vaccinated individuals. The model estimated that the probability of mpox extinction in Berlin exceeded 80% in 2023, with the probability reducing to less than 60% when extended to a European MSM metapopulation, and nearly zero when incorporating global metapopulation dynamics.

papers.title: Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023-May 2025.
papers.abstract: In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023-May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%-16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%-96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%-46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%-85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to assess possible unrecognized transmission of mpox virus in North Carolina, USA, following a new case identified in September 2023 after a 5-month gap since the last report. papers.source_body_en: In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%-16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%-96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%-46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%-85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response.

papers.title: Tell people and lose what I have: Care-seeking, concealment, and disclosure during Sierra Leone’s 2025 clade IIb mpox outbreak
papers.abstract: During Sierra Leone's 2025 clade IIb mpox outbreak, care-seeking occurred in a social context where formal presentation could expose symptoms, sexualised assumptions, and private relationships to families, workplaces, neighbours, and surveillance systems. We conducted a focused thematic analysis nested within a broader qualitative study across Western Area Urban, Western Area Rural, Bo, and Kenema from 10 March to 28 August 2025. The focused dataset held 70 transcripts. All 42 survivor interviews formed the primary evidence. The remaining 28 were contextual transcripts, drawn from interviews and focus group discussions with healthcare workers, contact tracers, and community members. Analysis used the Framework Method, dual coding, reflexive memos, matrix charting, and member checking with survivor participants. We identified four linked processes: protective misrecognition through socially safer diagnostic categories; disclosure risk as the point where stigma, cost, distance, relationship risk, and service trust converged; health system co-production of delay through early diagnostic uncertainty, referral gaps, and limited diagnostic access; and enabling conditions that made care-seeking safer, especially trusted intermediaries and visible confidentiality practices. Twenty-eight of the 42 survivor accounts met the criteria for pathway classification: 16 supported disclosure pathways and 12 forced concealment pathways, including three transitional cases that shifted after a trusted intermediary emerged. The other 14 survivor accounts lacked one or more pathway criteria and contributed contextual survivor evidence. Gender, intimate partnership risk, contact tracing visibility, and memories of Ebola and COVID-19 shaped disclosure decisions. The framework specifies how disclosure operates as a convergence point in high-stigma outbreak care-seeking. Outbreak preparedness should design confidentiality, intermediary, and contact-tracing systems that make disclosure safe enough to perform.

analysis.research_question_and_background: During Sierra Leone's 2025 clade IIb mpox outbreak, care-seeking occurred in a social context where formal presentation could expose symptoms, sexualised assumptions, and private relationships to families, workplaces, neighbours, and surveillance systems. The study aimed to understand the social and health system factors influencing care-seeking behaviors during the outbreak.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A focused thematic analysis was conducted across Western Area Urban, Western Area Rural, Bo, and Kenema from 10 March to 28 August 2025, involving 70 transcripts from 42 survivor interviews and 28 contextual transcripts from healthcare workers, contact tracers, and community members.
analysis.methods: The analysis used the Framework Method, including dual coding, reflexive memos, matrix charting, and member checking with survivor participants.
analysis.main_results: Four linked processes were identified: protective misrecognition through socially safer diagnostic categories; disclosure risk as the point where stigma, cost, distance, relationship risk, and service trust converged; health system co-production of delay through early diagnostic uncertainty, referral gaps, and limited diagnostic access; and enabling conditions that made care-seeking safer, especially trusted intermediaries and visible confidentiality practices.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provided a nuanced understanding of how disclosure decisions were influenced by social and health system factors, highlighting the importance of confidentiality, intermediaries, and contact-tracing systems in outbreak preparedness.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the design of confidentiality, intermediary, and contact-tracing systems that make disclosure safe enough to perform, thereby improving care-seeking behaviors during mpox outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's design limitations include the potential for selection bias and the reliance on self-reported data. The evidence strength is moderate due to the qualitative nature of the data and the need for further quantitative validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study explored care-seeking behaviors during Sierra Leone's 2025 clade IIb mpox outbreak, revealing how social and health system factors influenced disclosure decisions. The findings suggest the need for improved confidentiality and intermediary systems to enhance care-seeking during mpox outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在塞拉利昂2025年IIb系猴痘 暴发期间,求医行为发生在一种社会情境中,其中正式呈现症状可能暴露性行为假设和私人关系给家庭、工作场所、邻居以及监测系统。本研究旨在了解影响暴发期间求医行为的社会和卫生系统因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 于2025年3月10日至8月28日,在西方地区城市、西方地区农村、博城和肯马地区开展了一项聚焦主题分析,涉及42个幸存者访谈的70个转录文本,以及来自医护人员、接触追踪人员和社区成员的28个背景性转录文本。
elements_zh.methods: 分析采用了框架方法,包括双重编码、反思备忘录、矩阵图表和幸存者参与者的成员核查。
elements_zh.main_results: 识别出四个相互关联的过程:通过社会上更安全的诊断类别进行保护性误认;披露风险作为污名、成本、距离、关系风险和服务信任交汇的节点;通过早期诊断不确定性、转诊缺口和有限诊断可及性,卫生系统共同制造了延迟;以及使求医行为更安全的促成条件,尤其是受信任的中间人和可见的保密措施。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究提供了对披露决策如何受到社会和卫生系统因素影响的细致理解,强调了保密、中间人和接触追踪系统在暴发准备中的重要性。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: During Sierra Leone's 2025 clade IIb mpox outbreak, care-seeking occurred in a social context where formal presentation could expose symptoms, sexualised assumptions, and private relationships to families, workplaces, neighbours, and surveillance systems. The study aimed to understand the social and health system factors influencing care-seeking behaviors during the outbreak.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A focused thematic analysis was conducted across Western Area Urban, Western Area Rural, Bo, and Kenema from 10 March to 28 August 2025, involving 70 transcripts from 42 survivor interviews and 28 contextual transcripts from healthcare workers, contact tracers, and community members.
analysis_en.methods: The analysis used the Framework Method, including dual coding, reflexive memos, matrix charting, and member checking with survivor participants.
analysis_en.main_results: Four linked processes were identified: protective misrecognition through socially safer diagnostic categories; disclosure risk as the point where stigma, cost, distance, relationship risk, and service trust converged; health system co-production of delay through early diagnostic uncertainty, referral gaps, and limited diagnostic access; and enabling conditions that made care-seeking safer, especially trusted intermediaries and visible confidentiality practices.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provided a nuanced understanding of how disclosure decisions were influenced by social and health system factors, highlighting the importance of confidentiality, intermediaries, and contact-tracing systems in outbreak preparedness.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the design of confidentiality, intermediary, and contact-tracing systems that make disclosure safe enough to perform, thereby improving care-seeking behaviors during mpox outbreaks.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's design limitations include the potential for selection bias and the reliance on self-reported data. The evidence strength is moderate due to the qualitative nature of the data and the need for further quantitative validation.

papers.title_zh: 告诉他人并失去我所拥有的一切:塞拉利昂2025年IIb系猴痘 暴发期间的求医行为、隐瞒与披露
papers.source_body_en: During Sierra Leone's 2025 clade IIb mpox outbreak, care-seeking occurred in a social context where formal presentation could expose symptoms, sexualised assumptions, and private relationships to families, workplaces, neighbours, and surveillance systems. We conducted a focused thematic analysis nested within a broader qualitative study across Western Area Urban, Western Area Rural, Bo, and Kenema from 10 March to 28 August 2025. The focused dataset held 70 transcripts. All 42 survivor interviews formed the primary evidence. The remaining 28 were contextual transcripts, drawn from interviews and focus group discussions with healthcare workers, contact tracers, and community members. Analysis used the Framework Method, dual coding, reflexive memos, matrix charting, and member checking with survivor participants. We identified four linked processes: protective misrecognition through socially safer diagnostic categories; disclosure risk as the point where stigma, cost, distance, relationship risk, and service trust converged; health system co-production of delay through early diagnostic uncertainty, referral gaps, and limited diagnostic access; and enabling conditions that made care-seeking safer, especially trusted intermediaries and visible confidentiality practices. Twenty-eight of the 42 survivor accounts met the criteria for pathway classification: 16 supported disclosure pathways and 12 forced concealment pathways, including three transitional cases that shifted after a trusted intermediary emerged. The other 14 survivor accounts lacked one or more pathway criteria and contributed contextual survivor evidence. Gender, intimate partnership risk, contact tracing visibility, and memories of Ebola and COVID-19 shaped disclosure decisions. The framework specifies how disclosure operates as a convergence point in high-stigma outbreak care-seeking. Outbreak preparedness should design confidentiality, intermediary, and contact-tracing systems that make disclosure safe enough to perform.

papers.title: Detection of monkeypox virus in persons presenting skin lesions; benefits of One Health in passive surveillance.
papers.abstract: Abstract Mpox is a zoonosis caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV). Cases in Nigeria have risen to endemic status wherein infected persons seeking ethnoveterinary solution approached the Dermatophilosis Centre of the National Veterinary Research Institute. Of the 110 skin lesions seen in 2025, 6 had maculopapular rash suggestive of mpox. These and environmental samples collected in the household of an individual were analysed for generic orthopoxvirus and MPXV-specific antigens by quantitative polymerase chain reaction. Two skin and four environmental samples were orthopoxvirus and MPXV positive. These cases were referred to the Plateau State Ministry of Health for management. No further complication was observed at follow-up and these experiences underscored the benefit of One Health in passive surveillance at health and allied facilities.
papers.journal: Transactions of the Royal Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Mpox is a zoonosis caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV). Cases in Nigeria have risen to endemic status wherein infected persons seeking ethnoveterinary solution approached the Dermatophilosis Centre of the National Veterinary Research Institute. Of the 110 skin lesions seen in 2025, 6 had maculopapular rash suggestive of mpox. These and environmental samples collected in the household of an individual were analysed for generic orthopoxvirus and MPXV-specific antigens by quantitative polymerase chain reaction. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 猴痘是由猴痘病毒(MPXV)引起的一种人兽共患病。在尼日利亚,病例已上升至地方性流行状态,其中感染患者寻求传统兽医解决方案时前往国家兽医研究所的皮肤病中心。2025年共观察到110例皮肤病变,其中有6例表现为斑丘疹,提示猴痘。这些病例以及该个体家庭环境样本通过定量聚合酶链反应(PCR)分析了通用正痘病毒和MPXV特异性抗原。2个皮肤样本和4个环境样本为正痘病毒和MPXV阳性。这些病例被转介至Plateau州卫生部进行管理。随访期间未观察到进一步并发症,这些经验突显了One Health在被动监测中的优势,特别是在卫生及相关机构中。

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the maternal and pediatric use of vaccines for mpox, specifically addressing safety and effectiveness. The central question is the evaluation of the use of vaccines for mpox in these populations.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a living systematic review and meta-analysis, with no explicit mention of databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria. The review includes a sensitivity analysis for unmeasured confounding in meta-analyses and discusses the use of E-values for quantifying the potential importance of residual confounding.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that vaccination against mpox is effective, with no major areas of disagreement. The pooled estimate suggests a significant reduction in mpox incidence among vaccinated individuals.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There are controversies regarding the potential for unmeasured confounding, and the review highlights the need for sensitivity analysis to address this issue. The review also notes the importance of using E-values to quantify the potential impact of unmeasured confounding.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Specific priorities for research include further investigation into the effectiveness of vaccines in different populations and the development of strategies to mitigate the potential impact of unmeasured confounding.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the safety and effectiveness of vaccines for mpox in maternal and pediatric populations. It concludes that vaccination is effective, with no major controversies, but highlights the need for further research and sensitivity analysis to address potential confounding factors.

papers.summary_zh: 疫苗用于猴痘的母体和儿科使用:一项活的系统评价和荟萃分析的安全性和有效性。疫苗接种对抗猴痘的有效性:一项系统评价。伦理批准伦理委员会审查无需进行。数据和材料数据共享不适用于本文,因为当前研究中未生成或分析任何数据集。AI未用于生成科学内容、执行计算或解释结果。关于“疫苗用于猴痘的母体和儿科使用:一项活的系统评价和荟萃分析的安全性和有效性”的评论。参考文献 - Ciapponi A,Ballivian J,Berrueta M,et al. - VanderWeele TJ,Ding P. 观察研究中的敏感性分析:引入E值。- Ding P,VanderWeele TJ. 不假设的敏感性分析。- Mathur MB,VanderWeele TJ. 荟萃分析中的未测量混杂因素的敏感性分析。2020;115(529):163–72. - Verbeek JH,Whaley P,Morgan RL,et al. 一种量化系统评价中残留混杂因素潜在重要性的方法:一项GRADE概念论文。如何报告荟萃分析中的E值:推荐改进和添加到新的GRADE方法。- Schünemann HJ,Cuello C,Akl EA,et al. analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述专注于疫苗用于猴痘的母体和儿科使用,特别关注安全性和有效性。核心问题是评估疫苗在这些人群中的使用。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是一项活的系统评价和荟萃分析,未明确提及数据库、搜索日期或纳入标准。该综述包括未测量混杂因素的敏感性分析,并讨论了使用E值量化残留混杂因素潜在影响的方法。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,疫苗接种对抗猴痘是有效的,没有重大分歧。汇总估计表明,接种疫苗个体中猴痘 发病率的发病率显著降低。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于未测量混杂因素的潜在影响存在争议,综述强调需要进行敏感性分析以解决这一问题。综述还指出,使用E值量化未测量混杂因素潜在影响的重要性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究的具体优先事项包括进一步调查疫苗在不同人群中的有效性以及开发减轻未测量混杂因素潜在影响的策略。

papers.title: Differential pathogenesis and antiviral treatment outcomes of MPXV clade Ib and clade IIb in a BALB/c mouse model
papers.abstract: The global emergence of monkeypox virus (MPXV) clade IIb since 2022, together with the recent spread of clade Ib, underscores the continuing public health threat posed by MPXV. Clinical and epidemiological observations suggest that clade Ib infection may differ from clade IIb infection, but the biological basis of these differences remains insufficiently defined. In this study, we established an intranasal BALB/c mouse model of MPXV clade Ib infection and compared its pathogenicity with that of clade IIb. Clade Ib caused lethal disease at an inoculation dose approximately ten-fold lower than that required for clade IIb. Compared with clade IIb, clade Ib infection showed faster disease progression, higher pulmonary viral burden at later stages of infection, and more severe lung pathology. Single-cell transcriptome and cytokine response analyses further uncovered clade-specific differences in pulmonary immune cell landscapes, the distribution of MPXV-positive cells, and the expression patterns of key inflammatory mediators at specific time points. Antiviral evaluation showed that tecovirimat and cidofovir were active against both clades, although a higher dose of cidofovir was required to achieve protection in the clade Ib infection model. Together, these findings establish a susceptible BALB/c mouse model for MPXV clade Ib and provide experimental evidence for clade-dependent differences in MPXV pathogenicity and antiviral treatment outcomes.

papers.title_zh: MPXV Ib族和IIb族在BALB/c小鼠模型中导致不同发病机制和抗病毒药物 治疗结果
papers.source_body_en: The global emergence of monkeypox virus (MPXV) clade IIb since 2022, together with the recent spread of clade Ib, underscores the continuing public health threat posed by MPXV. Clinical and epidemiological observations suggest that clade Ib infection may differ from clade IIb infection, but the biological basis of these differences remains insufficiently defined. In this study, we established an intranasal BALB/c mouse model of MPXV clade Ib infection and compared its pathogenicity with that of clade IIb. Clade Ib caused lethal disease at an inoculation dose approximately ten-fold lower than that required for clade IIb. Compared with clade IIb, clade Ib infection showed faster disease progression, higher pulmonary viral burden at later stages of infection, and more severe lung pathology. Single-cell transcriptome and cytokine response analyses further uncovered clade-specific differences in pulmonary immune cell landscapes, the distribution of MPXV-positive cells, and the expression patterns of key inflammatory mediators at specific time points. Antiviral evaluation showed that tecovirimat and cidofovir were active against both clades, although a higher dose of cidofovir was required to achieve protection in the clade Ib infection model. Together, these findings establish a susceptible BALB/c mouse model for MPXV clade Ib and provide experimental evidence for clade-dependent differences in MPXV pathogenicity and antiviral treatment outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 自2022年以来,猴痘病毒(MPXV)IIb族在全球范围内的出现,以及Ib族近期的扩散,凸显了MPXV对公共卫生的持续威胁。临床和流行病学观察表明,Ib族感染可能与IIb族感染存在差异,但这些差异的生物学基础尚未充分阐明。在本研究中,我们建立了MPXV Ib族的鼻内BALB/c小鼠感染模型,并将其与IIb族的致病性进行了比较。Ib族在约十倍于IIb族所需的接种剂量下即可导致致命性疾病。与IIb族相比,Ib族感染表现出更快的疾病进展、感染后期更高的肺部病毒载量以及更严重的肺部病理变化。单细胞转录组和细胞因子反应分析进一步揭示了Ib族和IIb族在特定时间点肺部免疫细胞景观、MPXV阳性细胞分布以及关键炎症介质表达模式方面的特异性差异。抗病毒药物评估显示,特考韦瑞和西多福韦对两种族均有效,但为了在Ib族感染模型中实现保护,需要更高的西多福韦剂量。综上所述,这些发现确立了MPXV Ib族的易感BALB/c小鼠模型,并提供了关于MPXV致病性及抗病毒药物 治疗结果的族依赖性差异的实验依据。

papers.title: The risk of mpox false positive results in high transmission settings: evidence from a multi-site observational study in DR Congo.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Environmental viral DNA contamination is a recognised challenge for DNA viruses when using highly sensitive assays such as quantitative PCR (qPCR). We aimed to quantify the impact of environmental monkeypox virus (MPXV) DNA on routine mpox diagnosis and case ascertainment during a widespread outbreak in DR Congo. METHODS: For this multi-site observational study, we collected cycle threshold (Ct) values from 2724 people with a valid qPCR test who had mpox-compatible illness (ie, suspected cases) and attended mpox treatment centres across four locations (Goma, Kamituga, Kinshasa, and Uvira) in DR Congo between May, 2024, and April, 2026. In two of these locations (Uvira and Kamituga), we conducted surface sampling of clinic and laboratory environments. We developed a Bayesian latent class model to distinguish qPCR-positive results of true MPXV infections from those consistent with environmentally derived MPXV DNA, taking into account key biological features that can influence Ct values. We estimated the proportion of qPCR-positive results attributable to the environmental MPXV DNA burden by clinical and demographic factors and diagnostic Ct value cutoffs. Model-based classifications were externally evaluated with longitudinal serological data from a subset of participants. FINDINGS: We estimated that 35% (95% credible interval [CrI] 31-39) of qPCR results with Ct values less than 40 were likely to be false positive results and therefore consistent with the environmental burden of MPXV DNA rather than true infection. Among a subset of participants with serological data, 31 (88·6%) of 35 inferred as environmentally derived false positives had no serological evidence of orthopoxvirus infection, whereas 20 (66·7%) of 30 inferred as true infections had serological evidence of infection. Lowering the diagnostic cutoff to Ct values less than 37 reduced the false positive rate to 18% (95% CrI 16-20) and reducing the cutoff to less than 34 reduced the false positive rate to 5% (3-6), with only marginal losses in sensitivity. INTERPRETATION: More than one in three qPCR-positive mpox diagnoses in these settings might have been driven by the environmental MPXV DNA burden, with serological data independently supporting this finding. Strengthened decontamination of clinical areas, Ct value cutoffs optimised to the local context, and additional investigation of high-Ct specimens, including clinical progressions, epidemiological links, and repeat testing, could substantially improve diagnostic specificity while preserving sensitivity. FUNDING: Gates Foundation, Schmidt Science Fellows in partnership with the Rhodes Trust, European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP2 and EDCTP3), Belgian Directorate-General for Development Cooperation and Humanitarian Aid, and Research Foundation-Flanders. TRANSLATION: For the French translation of the abstract see Supplementary Materials section.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在刚果民主共和国的四个地点进行了多地点观察性研究,涉及2024年5月至2026年4月期间,2724名具有猴痘病毒检测兼容症状并前往猴痘检测中心的个体。
elements_zh.methods: 收集了qPCR检测的循环阈值(Ct)值,并在两个地点进行了诊所和实验室环境的表面采样。开发了一个贝叶斯潜类模型,以区分真正的MPXV感染和环境来源的MPXV DNA,并通过血清学数据进行了外部验证。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究估计,在Ct值低于40的qPCR结果中,约有35%为假阳性,归因于环境MPXV DNA。将诊断截止点降低至Ct值低于37,假阳性率降至18%;进一步降低至Ct值低于34,假阳性率降至5%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在这些环境中,超过三分之一的qPCR阳性诊断可能受到环境MPXV DNA负担的影响,血清学数据支持这一发现。优化Ct值截止点和对高Ct值样本进行额外调查可以提高诊断特异性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,加强临床区域的去污染、优化Ct值截止点以及进行额外调查,可以显著提高猴痘检测的特异性,同时保持其敏感性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的多地点设计和使用血清学数据进行外部验证支持了研究结果,但样本量和刚果民主共和国特定的环境条件可能限制其普遍适用性。

Strengthened decontamination of clinical areas, Ct value cutoffs optimised to the local context, and additional investigation of high-Ct specimens, including clinical progressions, epidemiological links, and repeat testing, could substantially improve diagnostic specificity while preserving sensitivity. analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在量化环境猴痘病毒(MPXV)DNA对刚果民主共和国广泛猴痘疫情期间常规诊断和病例确认的影响,应对高灵敏度检测方法中环境病毒DNA污染的挑战。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在刚果民主共和国的四个地点进行了多地点观察性研究,涉及2024年5月至2026年4月期间,2724名具有猴痘病毒检测兼容症状并前往猴痘检测中心的个体。
analysis_zh.methods: 收集了qPCR检测的循环阈值(Ct)值,并在两个地点进行了诊所和实验室环境的表面采样。开发了一个贝叶斯潜类模型,以区分真正的MPXV感染和环境来源的MPXV DNA,并通过血清学数据进行了外部验证。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究估计,在Ct值低于40的qPCR结果中,约有35%为假阳性,归因于环境MPXV DNA。将诊断截止点降低至Ct值低于37,假阳性率降至18%;进一步降低至Ct值低于34,假阳性率降至5%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在这些环境中,超过三分之一的qPCR阳性诊断可能受到环境MPXV DNA负担的影响,血清学数据支持这一发现。优化Ct值截止点和对高Ct值样本进行额外调查可以提高诊断特异性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,加强临床区域的去污染、优化Ct值截止点以及进行额外调查,可以显著提高猴痘检测的特异性,同时保持其敏感性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的多地点设计和使用血清学数据进行外部验证支持了研究结果,但样本量和刚果民主共和国特定的环境条件可能限制其普遍适用性。

papers.title: Global immuno-epidemiology and the persistence of mpox clade IIb in MSM
papers.abstract: In 2022, mpox clade IIb spread globally in men who have sex with men (MSM) via sexual contact. By summer 2022, case numbers declined in Europe and Norther America due to behavior change and immunization, with almost no reported cases in 2023, followed by low-level transmission. By autumn 2022, many susceptible individuals at high risk of transmission may have become immunized. Moreover, because individuals with mpox are infectious for only 2--4 weeks, sustaining transmission chains requires considerable infection throughput. This raises the question: How did mpox persist and transition to endemic circulation? We developed an agent-based model of mpox transmission on the Berlin MSM sexual contact network that incorporates viral shedding kinetics, vaccination, infection-derived immunity, immune waning, and case importations. After calibrating the model, we estimated that the probability of mpox extinction in Berlin exceeded $80\%$ in 2023, when acquired immunity fragmented the transmission network. Extending the analysis to a European MSM metapopulation reduced the extinction probability to less than $60\%$, whereas incorporating global metapopulation dynamics reduced it to nearly zero. We find that mpox persistence was enabled by epidemic asynchrony: When transmission declined in Europe/the Americas, mpox transmission continued in Asia, long enough for immune waning to partially restore transmission potential in Europe, thereby enabling subsequent re-importation and endemic circulation. These model-based findings are supported by phylogenetic evidence indicating that all active German transmission clusters are either linked to (i) re-importation of clade F from the Americas, or (ii) the emergence of clades C and E linked to Asia. Our findings on asynchronous transmission across connected global MSM networks highlight the role of global immuno-epidemiology in enabling mpox persistence and emphasize the importance of coordinated international surveillance and control efforts.

By summer 2022, case numbers declined in Europe and Norther America due to behavior change and immunization, with almost no reported cases in 2023, followed by low-level transmission. By autumn 2022, many susceptible individuals at high risk of transmission may have become immunized. Moreover, because individuals with mpox are infectious for only 2--4 weeks, sustaining transmission chains requires considerable infection throughput. This raises the question: How did mpox persist and transition to endemic circulation? We developed an agent-based model of mpox transmission on the Berlin MSM sexual contact network that incorporates viral shedding kinetics, vaccination, infection-derived immunity, immune waning, and case importations. After calibrating the model, we estimated that the probability of mpox extinction in Berlin exceeded $80%$ in 2023, when acquired immunity fragmented the transmission network. Extending the analysis to a European MSM metapopulation reduced the extinction probability to less than $60%$, whereas incorporating global metapopulation dynamics reduced it to nearly zero. We find that mpox persistence was enabled by epidemic asynchrony: When transmission declined in Europe/the Americas, mpox transmission continued in Asia, long enough for immune waning to partially restore transmission potential in Europe, thereby enabling subsequent re-importation and endemic circulation. These model-based findings are supported by phylogenetic evidence indicating that all active German transmission clusters are either linked to (i) re-importation of clade F from the Americas, or (ii) the emergence of clades C and E linked to Asia. Our findings on asynchronous transmission across connected global MSM networks highlight the role of global immuno-epidemiology in enabling mpox persistence and emphasize the importance of coordinated international surveillance and control efforts.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解猴痘 IIb系如何在全球男性同性性行为者(MSM)中持续传播并转变为地方性流行,特别是在2022年由于行为改变和疫苗接种导致病例数量下降之后。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用了一个基于代理的模型,模拟猴痘和传播在柏林MSM性接触网络中的传播,该模型纳入了病毒脱落动力学、疫苗接种、感染获得的免疫力、免疫衰退以及病例输入等因素,并使用2022年的数据进行校准。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型纳入了病毒脱落动力学、疫苗接种、感染获得的免疫力、免疫衰退以及病例输入等因素,并使用2022年的数据进行校准,以估计柏林以及欧洲MSM元种群中猴痘的灭绝概率。
elements_zh.main_results: 模型估计,2023年柏林猴痘的灭绝概率超过了80%;当分析扩展到欧洲MSM元种群时,灭绝概率降至低于60%;而当纳入全球元种群动态时,灭绝概率接近零。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究发现,猴痘的持续传播得益于流行病的异步性:当传播在欧洲和美洲下降时,猴痘在亚洲仍持续传播,时间足够长,使得免疫衰退部分恢复了欧洲传播的传播潜力,从而实现了后续重新输入和地方性流行。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现突显了全球免疫流行病学在猴痘持续传播中的作用,并强调了协调国际监测和控制措施的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括依赖模型来估计灭绝概率,这可能无法完全反映现实世界的复杂性,以及需要通过实证数据进一步验证。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括依赖模型来估计灭绝概率,这可能无法完全反映现实世界的复杂性,以及需要通过实证数据进一步验证。

papers.title: BIOMARKERS OF SEVERE MPOX: HEMATOLOGY-DRIVEN PROGNOSTIC PANEL- A PERSPECTIVE
papers.abstract: The 2022–2024 multi-country Mpox outbreaks have highlighted the urgent need for early, accessible prognostic tools to identify patients at risk of severe disease. Hematologic biomarkers offer a practical, low-cost approach for risk stratification, particularly in resource-limited settings. This perspective explores the potential of integrating common hematological parameters into a prognostic panel for severe Mpox, highlighting current evidence, limitations, and future research directions. The paper summarized the pathophysiological rationale for key hematologic markers including lymphopenia, neutrophilia, neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, thrombocytopenia, hemoglobin decline, and inflammatory indices as indicators of disease severity. Provisional thresholds for these biomarkers, currently extrapolated from analogous viral infections, are proposed to guide future validation studies. A structured severity framework is introduced to standardize clinical assessment and facilitate early risk stratification. Research gaps are discussed, including the need for Mpox-specific data, evaluation in immunocompromised populations, multicenter validation, and integration with therapeutic monitoring. Hematology-driven prognostic panels represent a promising approach for early identification of patients at risk of severe Mpox. By providing a practical, scalable tool, such panels could improve clinical management, guide treatment prioritization, and inform public health strategies. Future studies are essential to validate and refine these biomarkers for clinical implementation. Peer Review History: Received 3 June 2026; Reviewed 11 July 2026; Accepted 8 August; Available online 15 September 2026 Academic Editor: Dr. DANIYAN Oluwatoyin Michael, Obafemi Awolowo University, ILE-IFE, Nigeria, toyinpharm@gmail.com Reviewers: Dr. Sameh Abdelmoneem Mohammed Ali, Faculty of Pharmacy, Beni-Suef University, Egypt, same7_pharma18@yahoo.com Dr. Salfarina Ramli, Department of Pharmacology and Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Faculty of Pharmacy, Universiti Teknologi MARA, 42300 Puncak Alam, Selangor, Malaysia. salfarina2892@uitm.edu.my

papers.abstract_zh: 2022–2024年多国猴痘疫情凸显了早期、可及的预后工具的迫切需求,以识别重症风险患者。血液学生物标志物为资源有限地区的风险分层提供了一种实用且低成本的方法。本文从一种视角探讨将常见的血液学参数整合到猴痘重症预后面板中的潜力,强调当前证据、局限性以及未来研究方向。文章总结了淋巴细胞减少、中性粒细胞增多、中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值、血小板减少、血红蛋白下降以及炎症指标等关键血液学标志物的病理生理学依据,作为疾病严重程度的指标。目前这些生物标志物的临时阈值是基于类似病毒感染推导出来的,旨在指导未来验证研究。引入了一种结构化的严重程度框架,以标准化临床评估并促进早期风险分层。讨论了研究空白,包括需要猴痘特异性数据、免疫功能低下人群的评估、多中心验证以及与治疗监测的整合。以血液学为驱动的预后面板代表了一种早期识别猴痘重症风险患者的有前景方法。通过提供一种实用且可扩展的工具,此类面板可能改善临床管理,指导治疗的优先处理,并为公共卫生策略提供信息。未来的研究对于验证和优化这些生物标志物以实现临床应用至关重要。同行评审历史:2026年6月3日收到;2026年7月11日评审;2026年8月8日接受;2026年9月15日在线发布 学术编辑:多米尼克·奥卢瓦托因·迈克尔博士,奥法米·阿沃尔奥大学,尼日利亚,ILE-IFE,toyinpharm@gmail.com 评审者:萨梅赫·阿卜杜勒莫内姆·穆罕默德·阿里博士,埃及本·苏夫大学药学院,same7_pharma18@yahoo.com;萨尔法里娜·拉姆利博士,马来西亚博特拉大学药学院药理学与药学化学系,42300 Puncak Alam,Selangor,salfarina2892@uitm.edu.my

papers.title: Global immuno-epidemiology and the persistence of mpox clade IIb in MSM
papers.abstract: Abstract In 2022, mpox clade IIb spread globally in men who have sex with men (MSM) via sexual contact. By summer 2022, case numbers declined in Europe and Norther America due to behavior change and immunization, with almost no reported cases in 2023, followed by low-level transmission. By autumn 2022, many susceptible individuals at high risk of transmission may have become immunized. Moreover, because individuals with mpox are infectious for only 2-4 weeks, sustaining transmission chains requires considerable infection throughput. This raises the question: How did mpox persist and transition to endemic circulation? We developed an agent-based model of mpox transmission on the Berlin MSM sexual contact network that incorporates viral shedding kinetics, vaccination, infection-derived immunity, immune waning, and case importations. After calibrating the model, we estimated that the probability of mpox extinction in Berlin exceeded 80% in 2023, when acquired immunity fragmented the transmission network. Extending the analysis to a European MSM metapopulation reduced the extinction probability to less than 60%, whereas incorporating global metapopulation dynamics reduced it to nearly zero. We find that mpox persistence was enabled by epidemic asynchrony: When transmission declined in Europe/the Americas, mpox transmission continued in Asia, long enough for immune waning to partially restore transmission potential in Europe, thereby enabling subsequent re-importation and endemic circulation. These model-based findings are supported by phylogenetic evidence indicating that all active German transmission clusters are either linked to (i) re-importation of clade F from the Americas, or (ii) the emergence of clades C and E linked to Asia. Our findings on asynchronous transmission across connected global MSM networks highlight the role of global immuno-epidemiology in enabling mpox persistence and emphasize the importance of coordinated international surveillance and control efforts.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 2022年,猴痘 IIb系在全球通过性接触在男男性行为者(MSM)中传播。到2022年夏季,由于行为改变和疫苗接种,欧洲和北美地区的病例数量下降,2023年几乎无报告病例,随后出现低水平的传播。到2022年秋季,许多高风险传播易感个体可能已经获得免疫。此外,由于猴痘感染者仅具有2-4周的传染期,维持传播传播链需要大量的感染输入。这引发了一个问题:猴痘是如何持续并转变为地方性传播的?我们开发了一个基于代理的模型,模拟猴痘和传播在柏林MSM性接触网络中的动态变化,该模型整合了病毒脱落动力学、疫苗接种、感染获得性免疫、免疫衰退以及病例输入。在模型校准后,我们估计2023年柏林猴痘的灭绝概率超过了80%,当时获得性免疫已将传播网络碎片化。将分析扩展到欧洲MSM的元种群后,灭绝概率降至不到60%,而纳入全球元种群动态后,灭绝概率几乎降至零。我们发现,猴痘的持续存在得益于疫情异步性:当欧洲/美洲的传播下降时,亚洲的猴痘 传播仍在持续,时间足够长,使得免疫衰退部分恢复了欧洲的传播传播潜力,从而允许后续重新输入和地方性传播。这些基于模型的发现得到了系统发育证据的支持,表明所有活跃的德国传播簇要么与(i)从美洲重新输入的F系有关,要么与(ii)与亚洲相关的C和E系的出现有关。我们的研究结果表明,在连接的全球MSM网络中,传播的异步传播凸显了全球免疫-流行病学在维持猴痘持续传播中的作用,并强调了协调国际监测和控制措施的重要性。

papers.title: Mpox in Africa: one year continental response outcomes and way forward.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Following the declaration of mpox as both a global and continental public health emergency in August 2024, the Joint Incident Management Support Team (IMST), co-led by the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and the WHO, was activated in Kinshasa, DRC to coordinate the continental mpox response. This article highlights the first year's epidemiological and operational findings. METHODS: Key performance indicators across eight IMST pillars (coordination, surveillance, laboratory, case management, infection prevention and control, risk communication and community engagement (RCCE), vaccination and research) were descriptively analysed using data from 28 African Union Member States from January 2024 to August 2025. RESULTS: A total of 49 803 confirmed cases and 240 deaths (CFR 0.5%) were recorded across 28 countries. The response was supported with US$977 million as tracked by the IMST. Operational achievements included 87% surveillance completeness, 72% contact tracing completeness and improved average laboratory turnaround time from >5 days to 2 days. Laboratory testing capacity expanded from 2 to 27 sites in the DRC and from 1 to 56 decentralised sites in Burundi. RCCE activities reached 50 million people in 21 countries, with vaccine acceptance among high-risk groups rising from 44% to 87%. Operational research achievements included a responsive and functional research coordination mechanism, 24 (92%, 24/26) multi-country clinical and operational research studies implemented and 60% completion rate of the research data and material sharing framework for Africa. Only 938 000 doses (32%) of the 3.1 million vaccine doses delivered were administered. CONCLUSION: The joint continental IMST is a new benchmark for response governance, successfully mobilising resources and scaling up diagnostics under unified co-leadership. On the other hand, the evaluation revealed persistent structural challenges in last-mile vaccine delivery, contact tracing (due to stigma/funding) and weak regional collaborative research including fragmented regional research priorities. Future focus must shift from emergency action to durable, sustained investment in national and sub-national health security architecture using a multisectoral whole of government approach.

papers.title_zh: 猴痘在非洲:一年大陆响应结果与未来方向
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Following the declaration of mpox as both a global and continental public health emergency in August 2024, the Joint Incident Management Support Team (IMST), co-led by the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and the WHO, was activated in Kinshasa, DRC to coordinate the continental mpox response. This article highlights the first year's epidemiological and operational findings. METHODS: Key performance indicators across eight IMST pillars (coordination, surveillance, laboratory, case management, infection prevention and control, risk communication and community engagement (RCCE), vaccination and research) were descriptively analysed using data from 28 African Union Member States from January 2024 to August 2025. RESULTS: A total of 49 803 confirmed cases and 240 deaths (CFR 0.5%) were recorded across 28 countries. The response was supported with US$977 million as tracked by the IMST. Operational achievements included 87% surveillance completeness, 72% contact tracing completeness and improved average laboratory turnaround time from >5 days to 2 days. Laboratory testing capacity expanded from 2 to 27 sites in the DRC and from 1 to 56 decentralised sites in Burundi. RCCE activities reached 50 million people in 21 countries, with vaccine acceptance among high-risk groups rising from 44% to 87%. Operational research achievements included a responsive and functional research coordination mechanism, 24 (92%, 24/26) multi-country clinical and operational research studies implemented and 60% completion rate of the research data and material sharing framework for Africa. Only 938 000 doses (32%) of the 3.1 million vaccine doses delivered were administered. CONCLUSION: The joint continental IMST is a new benchmark for response governance, successfully mobilising resources and scaling up diagnostics under unified co-leadership. On the other hand, the evaluation revealed persistent structural challenges in last-mile vaccine delivery, contact tracing (due to stigma/funding) and weak regional collaborative research including fragmented regional research priorities. Future focus must shift from emergency action to durable, sustained investment in national and sub-national health security architecture using a multisectoral whole of government approach.

papers.title: Sentinel serosurvey for Mpox virus infection among key populations in India: Evidence of sporadic past exposure beyond travel-related cases
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Mpox, declared a public health emergency of international concern by WHO, has demonstrated sporadic transmission globally. While India reported 66 confirmed cases predominantly linked to international travel, the possibility of silent community circulation remains unconfirmed, particularly within high-risk populations. Serological surveys are crucial for detecting past exposure, including asymptomatic infections that may be missed by clinical surveillance. This study aimed to assess the prevalence of anti-MPXV IgG and IgM antibodies and identify socio-demographic and behavioural determinants of seropositivity among key populations in India. Methods A multicentric, cross-sectional sentinel serosurvey was conducted between September 2023 to March 2024 across seven community-based organisation sites in India. A total of 1,790 participants aged 18-40 y (born after cessation of smallpox vaccination in India) were enrolled. Serological testing was performed using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) for anti-MPXV IgG and IgM antibodies. Plaque reduction neutralisation test (PRNT50) was used to assess functional neutralising antibodies against both MPXV and Vaccinia virus. Results Among 1,790 participants, 14 (0.78%) tested positive for anti-MPXV IgG, with no IgM positivity detected. IgG-positive individuals were predominantly male (57.1%), aged 31-40 y (85.7%), and sexually active (75.9%). Geographic distribution ranged from 0.34% (Delhi NCR) to 2.07% (Kerala). PRNT50 assay revealed functional neutralising antibodies against MPXV in 64.3% (9/14) of IgG-positive samples, with evidence of cross-reactive immunity to Vaccinia virus in 93.9% (13/14). Interpretation and conclusions This multicentric sentinel serosurvey identified very low Mpox virus seroprevalence (0.78%) among key populations in India, suggesting limited prior exposure. The absence of IgM antibodies indicates that infections were not recent and provides no evidence of ongoing community transmission during the study period. Detection of neutralising antibodies in a subset of IgG-positive individuals supports prior Orthopoxvirus exposure. These findings establish baseline sero-epidemiological evidence for Mpox in India and underscore the importance of periodic sentinel sero surveillance for early detection and outbreak preparedness.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估印度关键人群中抗猴痘病毒IgG和IgM抗体的患病率,以了解病毒在非旅行相关病例之外的过去暴露范围。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023年9月至2024年3月期间,在印度七个基于社区的组织站点开展了多中心、横断面的哨兵血清学调查,共涉及1,790名年龄在18-40岁之间的参与者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用酶联免疫吸附测定(ELISA)进行血清学检测,以检测抗猴痘病毒IgG和IgM抗体,并通过斑块减少中和试验(PRNT50)评估针对猴痘病毒和天花病毒的功能性中和抗体。
elements_zh.main_results: 在1,790名参与者中,有14人(0.78%)检测出抗猴痘病毒IgG阳性,未检测到IgM阳性。地理分布范围从德里国家首都区的0.34%到喀拉拉邦的2.07%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,印度关键人群中猴痘病毒的血清流行率(0.78%)非常低,提示过去暴露有限。IgM抗体的缺失表明感染并非近期发生,且在研究期间没有证据表明社区中存在持续传播。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为印度猴痘病毒的血清流行病学提供了基线证据,并强调了定期进行哨兵血清监测对于早期检测和应对准备的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括多中心设计可能导致的潜在抽样偏差,以及缺乏关于过去暴露确切时间和背景的详细信息。由于样本量有限且没有近期感染的证据,研究结果的证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目的 由世界卫生组织宣布为国际关注的公共卫生紧急事件的猴痘病毒(MPXV)在全球范围内表现出零星传播。尽管印度报告了66例确认病例,主要与国际旅行有关,但高风险人群中是否存在无症状的社区传播仍不确定。血清学调查对于检测过去的暴露,包括临床检测可能遗漏的无症状感染至关重要。本研究旨在评估印度关键人群中抗MPXV IgG和IgM抗体的患病率,并确定血清阳性与社会人口学和行为特征之间的关系。方法 2023年9月至2024年3月期间,在印度七个基于社区的组织站点开展了多中心、横断面的哨兵血清学调查。共招募了1,790名年龄在18-40岁之间(出生于印度小pox疫苗接种停止后)的参与者。使用酶联免疫吸附测定(ELISA)进行血清学检测,以检测抗MPXV IgG和IgM抗体。通过斑块减少中和试验(PRNT50)评估针对MPXV和天花病毒的功能性中和抗体。结果 在1,790名参与者中,有14人(0.78%)检测出抗MPXV IgG阳性,未检测到IgM阳性。IgG阳性个体中,男性占多数(57.1%),年龄主要在31-40岁之间(85.7%),且有性活跃行为(75.9%)。地理分布范围从德里国家首都区的0.34%到喀拉拉邦的2.07%。PRNT50试验显示,在14份IgG阳性样本中有64.3%(9/14)检测出针对MPXV的功能性中和抗体,其中93.9%(13/14)显示出对天花病毒的交叉免疫。解释和结论 这项多中心哨兵血清学调查发现,印度关键人群中猴痘病毒的血清流行率(0.78%)非常低,表明过去暴露有限。IgM抗体的缺失表明感染并非近期发生,且在研究期间没有证据表明社区中存在持续传播。在部分IgG阳性个体中检测到中和抗体,支持了过去暴露的证据。这些发现为印度猴痘病毒的血清流行病学提供了基线证据,并强调了定期进行哨兵血清监测对于早期检测和应对准备的重要性。

papers.title: Meta-analysis of Asymptomatic Monkeypox Virus Prevalence in Nonendemic Regions, 2022–2024
papers.abstract: In this meta-analysis, we performed a literature search for articles relating to asymptomatic monkeypox virus (MPXV) detections published worldwide during May 12, 2022–September 13, 2024. The primary outcome was to determine the pooled prevalence of asymptomatic MPXV detections. We conducted a random-effects analysis that yielded a final pooled prevalence of 1.0% (95% prediction interval 0.1%–11.2%). Results did not substantially differ by geographic region or study design. Although those findings are reassuring, we did not evaluate infectivity or transmission potential among asymptomatic persons. MPXV continues to circulate globally; the viral dynamics that enable its persistence remain poorly understood and merit further study.

papers.abstract_original: In this meta-analysis, we performed a literature search for articles relating to asymptomatic monkeypox virus (MPXV) detections published worldwide during May 12, 2022–September 13, 2024. The primary outcome was to determine the pooled prevalence of asymptomatic MPXV detections. We conducted a random-effects analysis that yielded a final pooled prevalence of 1.0% (95% prediction interval 0.1%–11.2%). Results did not substantially differ by geographic region or study design. Although those findings are reassuring, we did not evaluate infectivity or transmission potential among asymptomatic persons. MPXV continues to circulate globally; the viral dynamics that enable its persistence remain poorly understood and merit further study.
papers.title_original: Meta-analysis of Asymptomatic Monkeypox Virus Prevalence in Nonendemic Regions, 2022–2024

analysis.scope_and_question: This meta‐analysis examined the prevalence of asymptomatic monkeypox virus (MPXV) detection worldwide between 12 May 2022 and 13 Sept 2024, aiming to quantify how often MPXV is present without symptoms.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The authors searched the literature for relevant studies published during the specified period and applied a random‐effects model to synthesize prevalence estimates.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Across the included studies, the pooled prevalence of asymptomatic MPXV was 1.0 % (95 % prediction interval 0.1–11.2 %), with no significant variation by region or study design.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The analysis did not assess whether asymptomatic individuals could transmit MPXV, leaving a key uncertainty about the role of silent infections in ongoing transmission.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further investigation into the viral dynamics that sustain MPXV circulation globally is warranted to inform control strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This meta‐analysis evaluated the prevalence of asymptomatic monkeypox virus (MPXV) detection worldwide from May 2022 to September 2024. By systematically searching the literature and applying a random‐effects model, the authors estimated a pooled prevalence of 1.0 % (95 % prediction interval 0.1–11.2 %). The prevalence did not differ significantly by geographic region or study design. However, the study did not examine the transmissibility of asymptomatic infections, leaving a critical gap in understanding silent transmission. The authors emphasize that MPXV continues to circulate globally and that the viral dynamics enabling its persistence remain poorly understood, underscoring the need for further research into MPXV’s ecological and epidemiological characteristics to guide effective public health interventions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本项元分析考察了2022年5月12日至2024年9月13日期间全球范围内无症状猴痘病毒(MPXV)检测的患病率,旨在量化MPXV在无症状情况下出现的频率。

papers.abstract_zh: 本项元分析对2022年5月12日至2024年9月13日期间全球发表的与无症状猴痘病毒(MPXV)检测相关的文章进行了文献检索。主要结果是确定无症状MPXV检测的汇总患病率。我们采用随机效应模型进行分析,得出最终汇总的患病率为1.0%(95%预测区间为0.1%–11.2%)。结果在地理区域或研究设计上没有显著差异。尽管这些发现令人放心,但我们并未评估无症状个体的感染性或传播传播潜力。MPXV在全球范围内持续传播;其维持传播的病毒动态机制仍不明确,需要进一步研究。

papers.title: The selection for cidofovir-resistant mutant vaccinia viruses is inhibited by coinfecting cidofovir-sensitive wildtypes
papers.abstract: Abstract Recent years have seen two outbreaks of zoonotic mpox, highlighting the need for additional therapies to treat these infections and curb the spread of the virus. However, there are only two antiviral drugs available for treating mpox, and drug resistance is a potential threat to intervention. Here we investigate how drug resistance emerges in a population of viruses where the sensitive wildtype strain vastly outnumbers the drug-resistant mutant. Using cidofovir treatment and resistance as a model system during vaccinia virus infection, we found that cidofovir-resistant poxviruses rapidly outcompete cidofovir-sensitive viruses when the two strains replicate in complete isolation. However, when the two strains infect the same cell, the drug-resistant virus lost its competitive advantage over the sensitive strain. We found that when the two viruses replicate in separate cells treated with cidofovir, the resistant strain displays faster genome replication kinetics compared to the sensitive strain. However, when the two viruses replicate in the same drug-treated cell, the strains replicated at the same rate. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在应对治疗猴痘感染和控制病毒传播的额外疗法需求,鉴于可用的抗病毒药物治疗选项有限,且存在药物耐药性的潜在风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了在牛痘病毒群体中,当敏感野生型病毒数量远多于耐药突变株时,药物耐药性如何出现,利用西多福韦治疗和耐药性作为模型系统。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究使用西多福韦治疗和耐药性作为模型系统,在牛痘病毒感染过程中,考察耐药性正痘病毒在完全隔离复制与共感染同一细胞时的竞争优势。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究发现,当两种菌株在完全隔离的细胞中复制时,西多福韦耐药性正痘病毒会迅速超越西多福韦敏感性病毒;然而,当两种菌株感染同一细胞时,耐药性病毒则失去了对敏感性菌株的竞争优势。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,共感染会抑制对罕见特征(如西多福韦耐药性)的选择,表明正痘病毒的共感染可能有助于维持群体的适应性,并促进正痘病毒群体中罕见有利特征的增殖。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,正痘病毒的共感染可能对药物耐药突变株的选择产生负面影响,这对开发治疗策略以控制正痘病毒感染的传播具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括仅使用单一模型系统,以及需要进一步研究共感染对药物耐药突变株选择的更广泛影响。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 近年来,出现了两种暴发的人兽共患病猴痘,凸显了需要额外疗法来治疗这些感染并控制病毒传播的必要性。然而,目前仅有两种抗病毒药物药物可用于治疗猴痘,而药物耐药性可能对干预措施构成潜在威胁。在此,我们研究了在病毒群体中,当敏感野生型病毒数量远多于耐药突变株时,耐药性如何出现。利用西多福韦治疗和耐药性作为模型系统,在牛痘病毒感染过程中,我们发现当两种菌株在完全隔离的细胞中复制时,耐药性病毒会迅速超越敏感性病毒。然而,当两种菌株感染同一细胞时,耐药性病毒则失去了对敏感性菌株的竞争优势。我们发现,当两种病毒在单独接受西多福韦处理的细胞中复制时,耐药菌株的复制动力学比敏感菌株更快。然而,当两种病毒在同一体内药物处理的细胞中复制时,它们的复制速率却相同。这表明,耐药性这一特性在两种遗传上不同的菌株之间具有功能上的共享性,使得敏感菌株能够寄生耐药菌株的生长优势,从而防止耐药菌株的快速增殖。这些观察结果表明,正痘病毒的共感染会抑制对罕见特征(如西多福韦耐药性)的选择。考虑到正痘病毒积极防止超级感染,我们推测超级感染排除机制可能有助于维持群体的适应性,并促进正痘病毒群体中罕见有利特征的增殖。作者摘要 正痘病毒感染仍然是公共卫生的威胁。虽然使用单一疗法通常是唯一的选择,但最终并不是理想的治疗策略,因为病毒更容易适应单一药物。理想情况下,应使用多种药物联合治疗正痘病毒感染,因为病毒很难在不失去复制能力的情况下适应所有药物。我们的数据支持这一模式,表明在正痘病毒群体中,耐药突变株可以在一轮复制中适应单一抗病毒药物药物。这些数据与该领域其他研究结果一致,显示正痘病毒可以非常迅速地适应抗病毒药物药物的选择压力。这源于正痘病毒采用多种分子策略来适应选择压力。随着越来越多的暴发正痘病毒感染事件发生,我们需要准备部署多种治疗策略来控制病原体的传播。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在应对治疗猴痘感染和控制病毒传播的额外疗法需求,鉴于可用的抗病毒药物治疗选项有限,且存在药物耐药性的潜在风险。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了在牛痘病毒群体中,当敏感野生型病毒数量远多于耐药突变株时,药物耐药性如何出现,利用西多福韦治疗和耐药性作为模型系统。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究使用西多福韦治疗和耐药性作为模型系统,在牛痘病毒感染过程中,考察耐药性正痘病毒在完全隔离复制与共感染同一细胞时的竞争优势。
analysis_zh.main_results: 本研究发现,当两种菌株在完全隔离的细胞中复制时,西多福韦耐药性正痘病毒会迅速超越西多福韦敏感性病毒;然而,当两种菌株感染同一细胞时,耐药性病毒则失去了对敏感性菌株的竞争优势。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,共感染会抑制对罕见特征(如西多福韦耐药性)的选择,表明正痘病毒的共感染可能有助于维持群体的适应性,并促进正痘病毒群体中罕见有利特征的增殖。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,正痘病毒的共感染可能对药物耐药突变株的选择产生负面影响,这对开发治疗策略以控制正痘病毒感染的传播具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括仅使用单一模型系统,以及需要进一步研究共感染对药物耐药突变株选择的更广泛影响。

papers.title: Mpox Outbreak in Côte d'Ivoire during 2024: Epidemiological, Clinical, Virological and Outcome Features of Hospitalised Cases in Abidjan
papers.abstract: Aims: To describe the epidemiological, clinical, virological and outcome features of Mpox patients hospitalised at the referral centre in Abidjan during the 2024 outbreak in Côte d'Ivoire, which totalled 89 confirmed cases nationwide. Study Design: Descriptive observational study. Place and Duration of Study: Department of Infectious and Tropical Diseases (SMIT), Treichville University Hospital, Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire, between June and October 2024. Methodology: We included all patients hospitalised at the SMIT with Mpox confirmed by real-time polymerase chain reaction (PCR) on skin lesion samples. Sociodemographic, clinical, virological (subclade typing by genomic sequencing at the Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire) and outcome data were collected using a standardised questionnaire. Qualitative variables were described as counts and percentages, and quantitative variables as medians with interquartile range (IQR). The in-hospital case fatality rate was estimated with its exact 95% confidence interval (CI). Results: Twenty-three patients were included (median age: 20 years [IQR: 11–40]; 18 males, sex ratio: 3.6), originating from four geographical clusters: Dianra in the north (n = 11), Abidjan in the south (n = 6), Sakassou in the centre (n = 4) and Iboké in the south-west (n = 2). No patient had been vaccinated against smallpox. The main features were skin rash (100%), fever (95.7%), headache (91.3%) and arthralgia (82.6%). Lesions were of moderate grade (10–99 lesions) in 19 patients (82.6%). Subclade IIa was identified in 22 patients (95.7%) and subclade IIb in one patient (4.3%). The median hospital stay was 13 days (IQR: 7–15). Bacterial superinfection was the main complication (21.7%). The in-hospital case fatality rate was 4.3% (95% CI: 0.1–21.9). Conclusion: In one of the first descriptions from Côte d'Ivoire, the outbreak was both rural and urban, affected young unvaccinated patients, was dominated by subclade IIa and had a generally favourable outcome. Surveillance, decentralised diagnosis and access to vaccination all need strengthening.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 描述2024年科特迪瓦暴发期间在阿比让转诊中心住院的猴痘患者的流行病学、临床、病毒学和结局特征,全国共有89例确诊病例。本研究旨在填补关于暴发地方特征的知识空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024年6月至10月期间,在科特迪瓦阿比让特里夫利医院(Treichville University Hospital)传染病与热带病科(SMIT)进行了一项描述性观察研究,纳入了23例确诊猴痘的住院患者。
elements_zh.methods: 通过标准化问卷收集社会人口学、临床、病毒学(通过基因组测序进行亚群分型)和结局数据。定性变量以计数和百分比描述,定量变量以中位数和四分位数范围(IQR)描述。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究纳入了23例患者(中位年龄:20岁 [IQR: 11–40];18例男性,性别比:3.6),所有患者均出现皮肤皮疹(100%),95.7%出现发热,91.3%出现头痛,82.6%出现关节痛。主要并发症为细菌继发感染(21.7%)。住院病例死亡率为4.3%(95% CI: 0.1–21.9)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 暴发在农村和城市地区均有传播,主要影响未接种疫苗的年轻患者,以亚群IIa为主导,总体结局较为良好。这是科特迪瓦首次对暴发的描述之一。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明需要加强监测、分散的诊断以及对疫苗接种的获取。本研究为了解科特迪瓦本地流行病学以及猴痘 暴发的临床特征提供了有价值的见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于样本量较小以及其为描述性观察研究的性质。研究结果的普遍适用性可能受到限制,住院病例死亡率的精确95%置信区间较宽。

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:描述2024年科特迪瓦暴发期间在阿比让转诊中心住院的猴痘患者的流行病学、临床、病毒学和结局特征,全国共有89例确诊病例。研究设计:描述性观察研究。研究地点和时间:2024年6月至10月期间,在科特迪瓦阿比让特里夫利医院(Treichville University Hospital)传染病与热带病科(SMIT)进行。方法:纳入所有在SMIT住院并经实时聚合酶链反应(PCR)检测皮肤病变样本确认为猴痘的患者。通过标准化问卷收集社会人口学、临床、病毒学(通过科特迪瓦巴斯德研究所的基因组测序进行亚群分型)和结局数据。定性变量以计数和百分比描述,定量变量以中位数和四分位数范围(IQR)描述。住院病例死亡率估计及其精确的95%置信区间(CI)。结果:共纳入23例患者(中位年龄:20岁 [IQR: 11–40];18例男性,性别比:3.6),来自四个地理集群:北部的迪安拉(n = 11)、南部的阿比让(n = 6)、中部的萨卡苏(n = 4)和西南部的伊博凯(n = 2)。无患者接种过天花疫苗。主要特征包括皮肤皮疹(100%)、发热(95.7%)、头痛(91.3%)和关节痛(82.6%)。19例患者(82.6%)的皮疹为中度(10–99个皮疹)。22例患者(95.7%)被鉴定为亚群IIa,1例患者(4.3%)为亚群IIb。中位住院时间为13天(IQR: 7–15)。主要并发症为细菌继发感染(21.7%)。住院病例死亡率为4.3%(95% CI: 0.1–21.9)。结论:这是科特迪瓦首次对暴发的描述之一,该病毒在农村和城市地区均有传播,主要影响未接种疫苗的年轻患者,以亚群IIa为主导,总体结局较为良好。需要加强监测、分散的诊断以及对疫苗接种的获取。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 描述2024年科特迪瓦暴发期间在阿比让转诊中心住院的猴痘患者的流行病学、临床、病毒学和结局特征,全国共有89例确诊病例。本研究旨在填补关于暴发地方特征的知识空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024年6月至10月期间,在科特迪瓦阿比让特里夫利医院(Treichville University Hospital)传染病与热带病科(SMIT)进行了一项描述性观察研究,纳入了23例确诊猴痘的住院患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过标准化问卷收集社会人口学、临床、病毒学(通过基因组测序进行亚群分型)和结局数据。定性变量以计数和百分比描述,定量变量以中位数和四分位数范围(IQR)描述。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究纳入了23例患者(中位年龄:20岁 [IQR: 11–40];18例男性,性别比:3.6),所有患者均出现皮肤皮疹(100%),95.7%出现发热,91.3%出现头痛,82.6%出现关节痛。主要并发症为细菌继发感染(21.7%)。住院病例死亡率为4.3%(95% CI: 0.1–21.9)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 暴发在农村和城市地区均有传播,主要影响未接种疫苗的年轻患者,以亚群IIa为主导,总体结局较为良好。这是科特迪瓦首次对暴发的描述之一。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明需要加强监测、分散的诊断以及对疫苗接种的获取。本研究为了解科特迪瓦本地流行病学以及猴痘 暴发的临床特征提供了有价值的见解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于样本量较小以及其为描述性观察研究的性质。研究结果的普遍适用性可能受到限制,住院病例死亡率的精确95%置信区间较宽。

news.content: Skip to main content Help Log in ReliefWeb Search Content Search What are you looking for? Search|t Updates Countries Disasters Organizations Topics Jobs Training Informing humanitarians worldwide 24/7 — a service provided by UN OCHA World Multi-country outbreak of mpox, External situation report #69 - 14 September 2026 Format Situation Report Source WHO Posted 15 Sep 2026 Originally published 14 Sep 2026 Origin View original Attachments Download Report (PDF | 889.85 KB) Highlights • WHO conducted a global mpox rapid risk assessment in August 2026; the overall global public health risk associated with the mpox multi-country outbreak was again assessed as moderate. • WHO continues to consider the ongoing multi-country mpox outbreak a graded emergency, with new outbreaks reported in multiple countries and over a thousand confirmed cases reported every month. All countries and partners are thus strongly encouraged to sustain surveillance and notification for mpox, along with coordinated preparedness and response activities in all technical areas in line with WHO guidance. • The WHO Director-General’s standing recommendations on mpox issued under the provisions of the International Health Regulations (2005) have, therefore, been extended until August 2027. • A global multi-partner initiative to improve access to mpox vaccines was launched on 27 August 2026 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The initiative creates a new long-term mechanism under the established International Coordinating Group (ICG) on Vaccine Provision for countries to request mpox vaccines for outbreak response. • Transmission of mpox continues to affect key populations largely through sexual transmission, often followed by household spread and community outbreaks. All clades of monkeypox virus (MPXV) continue to circulate. • In July 2026, 32 countries across four WHO regions reported 1370 confirmed mpox cases, including seven deaths (case fatality ratio [CFR] 0.5%). About three-quarters of these cases were reported in the WHO African Region. • In July 2026, Madagascar, Angola, China, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Kenya reported the most cases. • In July 2026, the WHO African region reported more confirmed cases than in June, while the Region of the Americas, Western Pacific, European, and South-East Asia regions reported fewer cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no confirmed cases in July 2026, like in June. • Eleven countries in Africa have reported active transmission of mpox in the last six weeks (6 July – 16 August 2026), with 1153 confirmed cases, including seven deaths (CFR 0.6%). Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Cameroon reported the highest number of cases during this period. • Two countries, Chile and Hungary, have reported mpox due to clade Ib MPXV for the first time. • Czechia, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Kingdom of the Netherlands, Portugal, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland (hereafter “the United Kingdom”) have reported community transmission of clade Ib MPXV, including among men who have sex with men. Related Content World WHO and Commonwealth Secretariat renew partnership to strengthen health systems and advance universal health coverage World + 23 more Pacific Syndromic Surveillance System Weekly Bulletin / Système de Surveillance Syndromic dans le Pacifique - Bulletin Hebdomadaire: W36 2026 (Aug 31-Sep 06) [EN/FR] World WHO at the United Nations General Assembly 2026 World Countries move to strengthen public health institutions and services amid mounting pressures

analysis.brief_en: This report from ReliefWeb, published on 15 September 2026, details a multi-country mpox outbreak assessed as moderate by the World Health Organization (WHO) in August 2026. The outbreak, considered a graded emergency, has seen over a thousand confirmed cases monthly, with the highest numbers in the WHO African Region. In July 2026, 32 countries reported 1370 cases, including seven deaths, with three-quarters of cases in Africa. Eleven African countries reported 1153 cases, including seven deaths, over the period from 6 July to 16 August 2026. Transmission is primarily through sexual contact, leading to household and community spread. The WHO has extended its recommendations on mpox until August 2027 and launched a global initiative to improve vaccine access in August 2026. The report emphasizes the need for sustained surveillance and coordinated response activities.

elements_zh.location_and_population: 该暴发疫情涉及四个WHO区域的多个国家,其中最高病例数出现在WHO非洲区域。具体提到的国家包括马达加斯加、安哥拉、中国、刚果民主共和国、肯尼亚、智利、匈牙利以及欧洲和美洲的其他国家。

elements_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: 2026年7月,32个国家报告了1370例已确认的猴痘病例,包括7例死亡(死亡率为0.5%)。这些病例中约四分之三发生在WHO非洲区域。在过去的六周内,有11个非洲国家报告了1153例已确认病例,包括7例死亡(死亡率为0.6%)。世界卫生组织评估全球公共卫生风险为中度。
elements_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 世界卫生组织继续认为该暴发疫情为分级紧急事件,并鼓励持续的监测和协调的准备行动。世卫组织总干事关于猴痘的建议已延长至2027年8月。一项旨在改善疫苗获取的全球倡议已于2026年8月启动。

news.title_zh: 多国暴发疫情,外部情况报告#69 - 2026年9月14日 - ReliefWeb
news.source_body_en: This report from ReliefWeb, published on 15 September 2026, details a multi-country mpox outbreak assessed as moderate by the World Health Organization (WHO) in August 2026. The outbreak, considered a graded emergency, has seen over a thousand confirmed cases monthly, with the highest numbers in the WHO African Region. In July 2026, 32 countries reported 1370 cases, including seven deaths, with three-quarters of cases in Africa. Eleven African countries reported 1153 cases, including seven deaths, over the period from 6 July to 16 August 2026. Transmission is primarily through sexual contact, leading to household and community spread. The WHO has extended its recommendations on mpox until August 2027 and launched a global initiative to improve vaccine access in August 2026. The report emphasizes the need for sustained surveillance and coordinated response activities.
news.content_zh: ReliefWeb于2026年9月15日发布的这份报告详细描述了2026年8月世界卫生组织(WHO)评估为中度的多国猴痘 暴发疫情。该暴发被视为分级紧急事件,每月已确认病例超过一千例,其中最高数量出现在WHO非洲区域。2026年7月,32个国家报告了1370例病例,包括7例死亡,其中四分之三的病例发生在非洲。在2026年7月6日至8月16日期间,有11个非洲国家报告了1153例病例,包括7例死亡。该暴发主要通过性接触传播,常导致家庭和社区传播。WHO已将关于猴痘的建议延长至2027年8月,并于2026年8月启动了一项全球倡议以改善疫苗的获取。报告强调需要持续的监测和协调的响应行动。

news.content: Skip to main content Services Residents Business Foreign Nationals Online Services About Contact Directory South Africa Government FAQs Links Documents What's new Constitution Acts All documents News What's new Cabinet statements Statements Speeches Events All news Jobs Search gov.za Search Breadcrumb Home > News > Media Statements > Health Calls For Public Vigilance As Mpox Cases Rise In SA Health calls for public vigilance as mpox cases rise in SA 18 Sep 2026 The Department of Health is urging citizens to remain vigilant of mpox symptoms as the country is experiencing a rapid increase in laboratory-confirmed mpox cases in the past few weeks. As of 17 September 2026, the country has recorded 18 confirmed and one probable case, and this requires immediate and sustained public cooperation to contain. The majority (15) of these cases were reported in the Western Cape, City of Cape Town in particular, 3 in Gauteng and 1 in KwaZulu-Natal. Of concern is that 13 of the total cases were recorded between 13 August and 17 September, which suggests a rapid local transmission of this preventable viral infection. All cases/patients range in age from 23 to 50 years, with a median age of 36.5 years, and 18 of them are males with only 1 female. One of the most recent cases involved an individual who travelled to Spain earlier this month and returned to South Africa on 14 September. This person underwent testing in Spain after being informed of his probable case status. South African health authorities are in are contact with the Spanish counterparts regarding laboratory test results of the individual to confirm his mpox status. Mpox cases may present in any person who was in close contact with someone who tested positive for the virus in the last few days (up to 21 days) and will present by displaying similar symptoms. The importance of continued surveillance, early detection, and public cooperation cannot be overemphasised in preventing further transmission. Mpox is a viral disease that can affect anyone regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation and socioeconomic status. Members of the public are reminded of mpox symptoms which include fever, headache, muscle aches, back pain, fatigue and rash or skin lesions that may appear on the face, hands, feet, genitals or other body parts. Typically, the skin lesions start as flat red spots before progressing to bumps, followed by fluid-filled blisters, then pus filled bumps and eruptions into crusted scabs. The symptoms usually appear within 6 to 13 days after exposure but can range from 5 to 21 days. Therefore, anyone experiencing these symptoms, particularly if they have had close contact with a confirmed case or a suspected case, should seek medical attention immediately and avoid close contact with others. Mpox is transmitted mainly through close physical contact with an infected person, including skin-to-skin contact with the rash or lesions, and contact with contaminated materials such as bedding, clothing, or towels used by an infected person. Mpox-positive persons can also transmit the virus through respiratory droplets during prolonged face-to-face contact, uncovered coughing or sneezing. Vigilance remains essential, particularly in households, healthcare settings and among close social networks. Hand hygiene through frequent washing or use of sanitisers is one of the effective methods to prevent the spread of the virus. The government, through the support of the World Health Organization, has secured limited doses of mpox vaccines (MVA-BN) and treatment (Tecovirimat) as part of its outbreak response strategy to disrupt local transmission. The health authorities will decide where and how to use these does to contain outbreaks. Vaccination should be accompanied by continued adherence to preventive measures. Individuals and communities are urged to support those diagnosed with mpox and those suspected of being infected with the virus, because stigma and discrimination have the potential to undermine an outbreak response by deterring people from seeking medical care. For more information and media enquiries, please contact: Mr Foster Mohale Departmental Spokesperson Cell: 072 432 3792 E-mail: Foster.mohale@health.gov.za Mr Sello Lediga Health Ministry Spokesperson Cell: 082 353 9859 E-mail: Sello.Lediga@health.gov.za #GovZAUpdates Issued by Department of Health More from Department of Health More on Health Share this page Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Similar categories to explore Media Statements

Mpox is transmitted mainly through close physical contact with an infected person, including skin-to-skin contact with the rash or lesions, and contact with contaminated materials such as bedding, clothing, or towels used by an infected person. Mpox-positive persons can also transmit the virus through respiratory droplets during prolonged face-to-face contact, uncovered coughing or sneezing. Vigilance remains essential, particularly in households, healthcare settings and among close social networks. Hand hygiene through frequent washing or use of sanitisers is one of the effective methods to prevent the spread of the virus. The government, through the support of the World Health Organization, has secured limited doses of mpox vaccines (MVA-BN) and treatment (Tecovirimat) as part of its outbreak response strategy to disrupt local transmission. The health authorities will decide where and how to use these does to contain outbreaks. Vaccination should be accompanied by continued adherence to preventive measures. Individuals and communities are urged to support those diagnosed with mpox and those suspected of being infected with the virus, because stigma and discrimination have the potential to undermine an outbreak response by deterring people from seeking medical care. news.content_zh: 南非卫生部呼吁公众保持警惕,因为猴痘病例在该国迅速上升。截至2026年9月17日,已确认18例,另有1例疑似病例,其中大多数(15例)报告在西开普省,尤其是开普敦市,另外3例在豪登省,1例在夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省。病例激增,其中13例发生在2026年8月13日至9月17日之间,表明病毒在当地快速传播。所有病例年龄在23至50岁之间,中位年龄为36.5岁,男性18例,女性1例。最近一例病例为一名于9月14日从西班牙返回并在当地检测的个体。南非卫生当局正与西班牙对应方协调确认该个体的状态。政府已获得有限剂量的猴痘 疫苗 和 治疗 作为应对策略的一部分。强调公众合作、监测,以及遵守预防措施,以遏制进一步的传播。病毒通过密切的身体接触传播,包括皮肤与皮损及受污染物品的接触,以及长时间面对面接触时的呼吸飞沫。出现症状的个人应立即就医并避免与他人密切接触。

supplementary_news.content_title: The cause of 2022's mpox outbreak revealed
supplementary_news.content: CONTINUE TO SITE >> Instrumentation Equipment Computing Lab fit-out R & D Business Connect The Magazine Events Videos Resources Products Business Directory About Us Life Scientist Subscribe Magazine Subscribe eNewsletter The cause of 2022's mpox outbreak revealed Wednesday, 16 September, 2026 A research team led by the University of Surrey has discovered that the strain of mpox behind the 2022 outbreak was a weakened form of the virus, which may have helped it to spread faster. Their findings have been published in the journal Nature Communications. Mpox is a viral infection which causes flu-like symptoms and leads to the development of a blistering rash. The virus is a member of the orthopoxvirus family, which also includes the now-eliminated smallpox. The World Health Organization has twice declared mpox a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) — the highest alert level for an extraordinary global health event. “Outbreaks of mpox across the globe are becoming more common and continue to cause concern amongst populations in regions affected,” said Professor Maluquer de Motes, who led the new study. “The virus has established human-to-human transmission chains and the dangers it poses cannot be underestimated. “Although a vaccine is now in existence, supply chain issues remain and it is often a logistical challenge to ensure those who are most at risk are vaccinated. The best form of defence is to arm ourselves with as much knowledge about the virus and how it is evolving.” The study saw scientists analyse the mpox strain (Clade IIB, lineage B.1) which infected over 100,000 people in 120 countries in 2022 and compare it to an ancestral form of the virus (Clade IIB, lineage A.1) from which it derived. The scientists found that the genetic variation between the viruses was minimal, with only 46 nucleotides differing between the two out of a possible 197,000 nucleotides. This small differentiation ultimately resulted in the 2022 strain being less severe than lineage A.1, with a reduced ability to disseminate between cells. “Compared to other viruses, the genetic composition of mpox is huge,” de Motes said. “Typically having a difference of 46 nucleotides would not warrant such a change in the behaviour of a virus; however, this is not the case with mpox.” The scientists found that these variations were not caused by virus replication errors, but by enzymes in the human body, known as APOBEC3. As the virus circulated in humans, the enzymes introduced mutations that weakened the virus. For example, the 2022 strain induced higher levels of the protein IFNβ, a protein that acts as the body’s frontline defence against viruses. It also showed a reduced ability to suppress signals from proteins responsible for decreasing inflammation. The scientists found that the 2022 strain was less aggressive to the overall health of laboratory mice, who limited virus dissemination more effectively and had an increased survival rate after exposure to this strain compared to lineage A.1. The scientists thus theorise that the mutations may have helped the virus spread globally, as a weakened form of the virus would have enabled patients to continue with everyday life, interact with others and unknowingly spread the virus. “We were very fortunate that the 2022 outbreak of mpox contained the mutated strain of the virus, which we have found is less severe than its ancestors,” de Motes said. These mutations are however absent in current circulating forms of the virus in parts of Africa. “The quick spread of the virus across borders and amongst people exposes the dangers of mpox and how we are not yet fully equipped to deal with another outbreak of a viral infection.” Image credit: iStock.com/Berkay Ataseven Related News Heart muscle regeneration genes mapped Researchers have uncovered insights into how stem cells develop and mature into heart muscle... supplementary_news.content_title: Portugal: Mpox transmission has increased since 2025, with 282 cases this year | Macau Business
supplementary_news.content: About Us Search MNA Macau China International Gaming Finance Opinion Editorial Special Reports Partner Content More MNAInternational 16 Sept 2026 Portugal: Mpox transmission has increased since 2025, with 282 cases this year By LUSA Since 2025, Portugal has seen an increase in mpox transmission, with 282 confirmed cases so far this year, but the number of infections has been declining in recent weeks, the Directorate-General for Health (DGS) announced on Tuesday. «Since 2025, there has been an increase in mpox transmission in the country. Between 1 January and 31 August 2026, health authorities confirmed 282 cases of mpox in Portugal, with the highest numbers occurring from the end of May onwards, particularly in June and July,» the DGS told the Lusa news agency. According to the Directorate-General, 18 people – 6.4% of the 282 cases confirmed this year – required hospitalisation, a proportion similar to that recorded during the same period in 2025 (6.5%). An epidemiological analysis by the World Health Organisation (WHO), released on Monday, indicated that Portugal has recorded community transmission of the lb subvariant of the virus that causes the infectious disease mpox, having recently reported a total of 66 cases of infection with this lineage. «Community transmission of the MPXV (mpox virus) lb clade outside Central and East Africa has been reported in the Czech Republic, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, including within sexual networks of men who have sex with men and/or sex workers,» the United Nations public health agency wrote. A country is classified as having community transmission when at least one case reported in the last six weeks is not linked to recent travel or to a traveller from a country with community transmission during the incubation period. According to the DGS today, following the surge in infections recorded in May, June and July, the number of cases has decreased in recent weeks. The confirmed infections mainly involve men (97.9%, with an average age of 35), and the Lisbon and Tagus Valley region accounts for the majority, representing 66.7% of the total. Of the cases recorded in men, «81.2% had sexual relations with other men, maintaining an epidemiological profile similar to that previously observed», the DGS added. With regard to virus variants, the Directorate-General identified clade I in 80.5% of cases, adding that 13 ‘clusters’ – that is, small groups of epidemiologically linked cases – had been identified, with an average of 2.4 cases per ‘cluster’. Clade Ib was identified in nine of these ‘clusters’, as mentioned in the WHO report, seven of which were in the Lisbon and Tagus Valley region. The DGS also emphasised that it has maintained a strategy to prevent and respond to mpox, including providing information to the public and healthcare professionals, awareness-raising initiatives, and campaigns to promote vaccination available through the National Health Service (SNS), carried out in collaboration with health authorities and community-based organisations. «These initiatives, which will continue, have sought to improve understanding of the modes of transmission, the signs and symptoms of the disease, preventive measures and the importance of vaccination amongst those at greatest risk of exposure,» it stated. The Director-General also emphasised the importance of taking preventive measures and seeking timely healthcare if symptoms consistent with mpox appear, such as lesions on the skin or mucous membranes, fever or swollen lymph nodes. If these symptoms are present, people should maintain physical distance from others and contact the National Health Service 24 (SNS 24) on 808 24 24 24, or consult a healthcare professional, the DGS urged. The virus spreads through close physical contact, particularly with lesions or bodily fluids, or through contact with contaminated items such as bed linen, towels, or personal items.
